string[][] boards := [
    ["XXX", "OO.", "O.X"], ["X.O", ".X.", "O.."], ["XO.", ".OX", "XO."], ["XOX", "XOO", "OXX"],
    ["X.O", "XO.", "O.X"], ["XOX", "OXO", "OXX"],
]
int[][] lines := [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8], [0, 3, 6], [1, 4, 7], [2, 5, 8], [0, 4, 8], [2, 4, 6]]
for: i < 6
    flat := boards[i].join("")
    result := if flat.contains(".") then "in progress" else "draw"
    for line := lines[]
        mark := flat[line[0]]
        if mark != "." and mark == flat[line[1]] and mark == flat[line[2]]
            result = mark + " wins"
            break
    println("board {i + 1}: {result}")
